text:
Maya: Quick follow-up from today — can someone confirm the shipping windows for the Console rate-limits UI and the Optimize recommendations (the one that suggests batching + quantization profiles)? Need to give a customer an expected beta date.

Elle (Product): Console rate-limits UI: targeting a private beta in mid-May, broader beta late June. Optimize recommendations: internal beta next week, public beta targeted for July. gating depends on docs and a small canary.

Ryan (Eng): To add — Console UI depends on the new quota service rollout (infra) which we're scheduling for the week before mid-May. If that slips, UI beta slides by ~2 wks.

Tess (DevEx): Docs + SDK changes for the new rate-limit controls — ETA for doc PRs? I can start draft templates now.

Elle (Product): Tess, please draft templates by end of this week. We'll review with the API team Mon.

Kevin (Sales): FYI we have a few MQLs asking about per-route limits + console toggles. If June is realistic for public beta, I can start pre-sales briefings in early June.

Anil (ML): For Optimize recommendations: the quantization guidance relies on the new evaluation harness to detect quality regressions. We're finishing integration tests this week. If they pass, July beta looks good.

Ryan (Eng): Also note: Optimize's batching suggestion requires the runtime batching knobs exposed via config API — that's a small eng task but needs validation on Dedicated. Can we scope Dedicated support into the beta or keep it hosted-only?

Elle (Product): Hosted-only for the initial public beta. Dedicated support as an opt-in in Q3. We don't want to block public beta on Dedicated validation.

Maya: Thanks. Can we get a concise one-liner I can share with the customer for each item (Console rate-limits UI, Optimize recommendations) + any hard caveats?

Elle (Product): One-liners: "Console rate-limits UI: private beta mid-May, public beta late June; depends on quota service rollout — possible 2-week delay if infra slips." / "Optimize recommendations: internal beta next week, public beta targeted for July; initially hosted-only, Dedicated support planned in Q3; quality regressions guarded by the new eval harness."

Tess (DevEx): I'll convert those into a short FAQ + a minimal SDK snippet. Example snippet for toggling route limits:

```
POST /v1/console/route-limits
{ "route_id": "checkout", "limit_per_min": 1200 }
```

Ryan (Eng): deploy-bot: can you post the current quota-service deploy status?

deploy-bot: Quota service deploy in progress — 3/4 nodes updated, health checks passing. Expected completion: 2198765480.

Anil (ML): Also proposing a small smoke eval for Optimize recommendations — run a 100-prompt regression set across released models. Can we schedule that once the integration tests finish?

Elle (Product): Good call. Anil, please coordinate with Ryan on infra for the smoke eval.

Ryan (Eng): I'll provision a 2-hour slot on Friday for the smoke run and leave an instance for Dedicated validation early next week.

Kevin (Sales): I'll hold off customer briefs until Tess posts the FAQ. If we get the FAQ by Monday, I can loop in accounts next Tue.

Tess (DevEx): Draft FAQ + SDK snippet PR opened: https://git.internal.redwood/docs/pull/432 (WIP). Comments welcome.

Maya: Perfect. Final ask: can someone add these shipping windows to the roadmap doc and tag owners? I'll need to reference that in the customer note.

Elle (Product): Done — added entries under "Console" and "Optimize" with owners @Tess and @Anil; will update timelines if quota-service deploy slips.

Maya: Awesome, thanks all :thumbsup:
